messages.subject: GoogleVis Interactivity between graphs
parts:
Hi Everyone,

I am building a site to teach basic statistics, and would like to have a series of GoogleVis graphs and a table that interact with each other. The start of my page can be found at spark.rstudio.com/scm/resid/ 

Basically, when you click in one scatter chart, I would like a corresponding point in another chart to be selected (and the data row in a table).  I am currently using getSelection to identify the point selected.  An earlier version of my page (spark.rstudio.com/scm/resid-old/) shows that when you select a point, the corresponding point is plotted to another scatter graph (the residual from a regression line).

I have been trying to get setSelection to work, but with out any success.  What I have tried so far is to simply set the 4th row for the table to see if setSelection is working.

jscode <- "table.setSelection([{'row': 4}]);"

Any help would be appreciated.

Thanks,

Allen
